summary: Master policy implementation and compliance assurance with practical templates, monitoring tools, and reporting workflows. Enrol to strengthen control execution
lede: Policy implementation and compliance assurance turns written requirements into assigned controls, evidence checks and follow-up. It is designed for professionals who manage policy rollout, controls, audits or operational compliance, and covers policy-to-control mapping, ownership through RACI, and role-based rollout. Learners practice assessing compliance baselines, testing evidence, tracking exceptions and corrective actions, and producing assurance reports and dashboards for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with policies, controls, audits, or operational compliance and now need to strengthen execution discipline. You should see yourself in roles that manage policy rollout, evidence collection, monitoring, or assurance reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with policy documents, monitoring templates, and reporting examples. Familiarity with Excel, SharePoint, or Power BI is useful, and you may optionally bring a current policy, a recent audit finding, or a compliance checklist from your own work.
